title: India runs 10,000 reefer trucks. It needs 62,000.
takeaways: Market at ₹1.32 lakh crore in 2026, 8.62% CAGR to 2034 (IMARC)
8,815 cold storages hold 402.18 lakh tonnes (PIB, June 2025)
Only about 4% of perishables use organised cold chains (ASSOCHAM)
Fruit losses run 6.02% to 15.05% of output (NABCONS)
Capacity grows just 2.2% a year to 2031 (NCCD)
source_note: Sources: IMARC 2026; PIB 2025; ASSOCHAM-ASCELA 2026; NABCONS via Lok Sabha; NCCD
